# Widget reference

Only these widgets may be used in generated courses. Each page has an example and a props table.

| Widget | Pack | When to use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`order-items`](order-items.md) | core | Use when the material has a fixed sequence (process steps, stages, a chronology) the learner should be able to reproduce. |
| [`match-pairs`](match-pairs.md) | core | Use for one-to-one associations: term ↔ definition, word ↔ translation, cause ↔ effect, symbol ↔ meaning. |
| [`categorize`](categorize.md) | core | Use when items belong to 2–4 classes the learner must tell apart (types, families, true/false groups). |
| [`cloze`](cloze.md) | core | Use for a key definition or rule whose exact wording matters; each {{gap}} hides one important word. |
| [`flow-stepper`](flow-stepper.md) | core | Use for a process, pipeline or decision flow where each step deserves a short explanation. |
| [`concept-map`](concept-map.md) | core | Use to show how 3–14 key ideas relate to each other through labelled links. |
| [`chart`](chart.md) | core | Use when the material gives numbers to compare (bar) or a trend over time or a variable (line). |
| [`parameter-explorer`](parameter-explorer.md) | math | Use for a formula with 1–4 inputs so the learner can move sliders and watch the results change. |
| [`function-plot`](function-plot.md) | math | Use to plot a function of x, optionally with up to 3 parameter sliders, to build intuition for its shape. |
| [`mock-exam`](mock-exam.md) | core | Use once, in the exam page: a timed quiz drawn from all lecture quizzes. |

Packs: **core** — Any subject. **math** — Formulas and functions (Math, physics, economics, CS performance).

The `dis` pack holds course-specific labs of the Data-Intensive Systems example and is not for
new courses.
